subsection.name: Additional Audit Information
description: Generate audit records containing the following additional information: organization defined additional information

subsection.name: Limit Personally Identifiable Information Elements
description: limit personally identifiable information contained in audit records to the following elements identified in the privacy risk assessment: organization defined elemnts

subsection.name: Transfer to Alternate Storage
description: transfer audit logs organization defined frequency to a different system, system component, or media other than the system or system component conducting the logging

subsection.name: AU-5 - Response to Audit Logging Process Failure
Storage Capacity Warning
description: provide a warning to organization defined personnel, roles, and/or locations within organization defined time period when allocated audit log storage volume reaches organization defined percentage of repository maximum audit log storage capacity

subsection.name: Real Time Alerts
description: provide an alert within organization defined real time period to organization defined personnel, roles, and/or locations when the following audit failures events occur: organization defined audit logging failure events requiring real time alerts

subsection.name: Configurable Traffic Volume Thresholds
description: enforce configurable network communications traffic volume thresholds reflecting limits on audit log storage capacity and reject, delay network traffic above those thresholds

subsection.name: Shutdown on Failure
description: invoke a fully system shutdown, partial system shutdown, degraded operational mode with limited mission or business functionality available in the event of organization defined audit logging failures, unless an alternate audit logging capability exists

subsection.name: Alternate Audit Logging Capability
description: provide an alternate audit logging capability in the event of a failure in primary audit logging capability that implements organization defined alternate audit logging functionality

subsection.name: AU-6 - Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
Automated Process Integration
description: integrate audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes using organization defined auotmated mechanisms

subsection.name: Correlate Audit Record Repositories
description: analyze and correlate audit records across different repositories to gain organization wide situational awareness

subsection.name: Central Review and Analysis
description: provide and implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system

subsection.name: Integrated Analysis of Audit Records
description: integrate analysis of audit records with analysis of vulnerability scanning information, performance data, system monitoring information, organization data/information collected from other sources to further enhance to identify inappropriate or unusual activity

subsection.name: Correlation with Physical Monitoring
description: correlate information from audit records with infomration obtained from monitoring physical acess to further enhance the ability to identify suspicious, inappropriate, unusual, or malevolent activity

subsection.name: Permitted Actions
description: specify the permitted actions for each system process, role, user associated with the review, analysis, and reporting of audit records information

subsection.name: Full Text Analysis of Privileged Commands
description: perform a full text analysis of logged privileged commands in a physically distinct component or subsystem of the system, or other system that is dedicated to that analysis

subsection.name: Correlation with Infomration from Nontechnical Sources
description: correlate information from nontechnical sources with audit record information to enhance organization wide situational awareness

subsection.name: AU-7 - Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation
Automatic Processing
description: provide and implement the capability to process, sort, and search audit records for events of interest based on the following content: organization defined fileds within audit records

subsection.name: Hardware Write Once Media
description: write audit trails to hardware enforced, write once media

subsection.name: Store on Separate Physical Systems or Components
description: store audit records at organization defined frequency in a repository that is part of a physically different system or system component than the system or component being audited

subsection.name: Cryptographic Protection
description: implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of audit information and audit tools

subsection.name: Access by Subset of Privileged Users
description: authorize access to management of audit logging functionality to only organization defined subset of privileged users or roles

subsection.name: Dual Authorization
description: enforce dual authorization for movement, deletion of organization defined audit informaiton

subsection.name: Read Only Access
description: authorize read only access to audit information to organization defined subset of privileged users or roles

subsection.name: Store on Component with Different Operating System
description: store audit informaiton on a component running a different operating system than the system or component being audited

subsection.name: Association of Identities
description: bind the identity of the infomraiton producer with the infomraiton to organization defined strength of binding
provide the means for authorized individuals to determine the identity of the producer of the informaiton

subsection.name: Validate Binding of Information Producer Identity
description: validate the bindiing of the information producer identity to the information at organization defined frequency
perform organization defined actions in the event of a validation error

subsection.name: Chain of Custody
description: maintain reviwer or releaser credentials within the established chain of custody for information reviewed or released

subsection.name: Validate Binding of Information Reviewer Identity
description: validate the binding of th einformation reviewer identity to the information at the transfer or release points prior to release or transfer between organization defined security domains
perform organization defined actions in the event of a validation error

subsection.name: Long Term Retrieval Capability
description: employ organization defined measures to ensure that long term audit records generated by the system can be retrieved

subsection.name: System Wide and Time Correlated Audit Trail
description: compile audit records from organization defined system components into a system wide (logical or physical) audit trail that is time correlated to within organization defined level of tolerance for the relationship between time stamps of individual records in the audit trail

subsection.name: Standardized Formats
description: produce a system wide (logical or physical) audit trail composed of audit records in a standardized format

subsection.name: Changes by Authorized Individuals
description: provide and implement the capability for organization defined individuals or roles to change the logging to be performed on organization defined system components based on organization defined selectable event criteria within organization defined time thresholds

subsection.name: Query Parament Audits of Personally Identifiable Information
description: provide and implement the capability for auditing the parameters of user query events for data sets containing personally identifiable information

subsection.name: Use of Automated Tools
description: monitor open source information and information sites using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Review of Monitored Sites
description: review the list of open source information sites being monitored organization defined frequency

subsection.name: Unauthorized Replication of Informaiton
description: employ discovery techniques, processes, and tools to determine if external entities are replicating organizational information in an unauthorized manner

subsection.name: System Start Up
description: intitiate session audits automatically at system start up

subsection.name: Remote Viewing and Listeniing
description: provide and implement the capability for authorized users to remotely view and hear content related to an established user session in real time

subsection.name: Cross Organizational Audit Logging
description: preserve the identity of individuals in cross organizational audit trails

subsection.name: Sharing of Audit Information
description: provide cross organizational audit information to organization defined organizations based on organization defined cross organizational sharing agreements

subsection.name: Disassociability
description: implement organization defined measures to disassociate individuals from audit information transmitted across organizational boundaries
